Works inside a sum, where the result is reordered into canonical form

expr: [MapAt, h, [List, [List, a, b, c], [List, d, k], f, g], 2]

wolfram.note: position List[1] given TWICE in the position spec should apply f twice at that position (f[f[a]]) per Wolfram; ours applies f once per distinct position (dedupes via a Set), so a repeated position only gets one application
